Package de.labathome.trustconstr

Class BFGS

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.FullHessianUpdateStrategy
de.labathome.trustconstr.BFGS
All Implemented Interfaces:
HessianUpdateStrategy, BiFunction<Matrix,Object,Matrix>
public class BFGS extends FullHessianUpdateStrategy
Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno (BFGS) Hessian update strategy.

The update follows Nocedal & Wright, Numerical Optimization, 2nd ed. (2006), p.140.
